items.question: How do I place my order?
items.answer: Pick a template, upload your photos, and customize your album in the editor. When you're done, confirm your order and pay online.

items.question: How long does my order take to arrive?
items.answer: Between 5 and 10 business days anywhere in Ecuador, depending on your city.

items.question: How much can I customize my album?
items.answer: You can change text, colors, the cover, and the photo order. The editor saves your changes automatically.

items.question: What album sizes do you have?
items.answer: Wiski Ruta comes in 21x30 cm and Wiski Momento in a 15x15 cm mini format.
